edits.new:
Proof of delivery is held behind its feature flag until RWB-ACE-001 lands and v_ace_pod is available; the fallback (proof entered by hand against the barcode) is agreed with the litigation business owner before wave 2 (GAP-1608).

Until RWB-ACE-001 deploys the Section B views, the proof-of-delivery read is held behind the platform flag rwb.dataengine.pod-read. While the flag is off or the views are not deployed, the read answers 200 with no row, the ten proof-of-delivery field names marked not available with reason SECTION_B_NOT_DEPLOYED, freshness DP07 STALE and message MSG-P1-001. It never returns an empty list alone, never a guessed date and never a fallback to data_as_of.

A repeat proof-of-delivery read of the same business date is counted on the DP07 stamp of that business date: one increment of data_product_load.duplicate_count per repeat read. The repeat writes no interaction ledger row and no log-only hit.

The delivery entry is written by the proof-of-delivery read, through the interaction ledger writer of this service, in the same transaction as the read, for the caseId the caller names on the read. A read without caseId writes nothing. rwb-comms writes only the dispatch entry.

The proof is read through the P1 contract on the business date of the ACE batch and matched to the notice by barcode. On a match the delivery date is set on the notice and EV-15 NoticeDelivered is published from rwb-comms. No new event and no new job is introduced.
